meta.semantics: compound this-offset fingerprint evidence: function FN's traced-this accesses {(off,width,dir)} AND-matched against class layouts; candidate list = classes whose flat layout covers EVERY fingerprint tuple (a<=off and off+max(w,1)<=a+b, char[N] continuous coverage counts). Emitted only when distinct offsets >= 3 and 1 <= |candidates| <= 8.
meta.method: [reg+off] accesses; base reg traced to this via label/jmp-bounded <=8-instr back-scan with <=3 copy hops (machinery adapted from .omo/agents/vrorg/extract_vr_origins.py); entry-ecx undef-since-entry = this (thiscall|fastcall); thiscall arg0 ([ebp+8]/arg_0) passthrough = this. Width: operand prefix (byte/word/dword/qword ptr) else other-operand register size else 4; movzx/movsx source width requires prefix; lea = point containment (w=0); tbyte/FPU-store-without-prefix skipped. Dir: mem-as-dest mov/pop/fst*/setcc=w, arith/inc/xchg=rw, mem-as-src mov/cmp/test/push/fld/imul/call=r.
meta.layouts: class -> {off: width} merged: tools/class_layouts.json (declared, priority) > anchors/csp_canon_members.json > anchors/member_types.json (width from type string, char[N] arrays keep N); inheritance flattened absolute via class_layouts.parent + anchors/rtti_base_arrays.json[1] primary base; eff_size = max(declared size, max member end); gates: eff_size >= need and eff_size <= 6*need (parity with C18). Members >32B are opaque blobs: kept for size accounting, excluded from coverage spans (zero discrimination). Member width/offset sanitized (<=4096 / <=65536).
meta.c18_dedup: C18 load source (minclass_solver.py raw_constraints.json MEMBER_ACCESS base 'FN:this'): 8302 functions; entities already carrying C18 observations are still emitted here for AND-merge but flagged c18_overlap=true (456 of emitted).

tiers.strict: base defs resolved within label-bounded <=8-instr windows (sound reaching def on every path)
tiers.fullspan: entry-this alias via LAST textual def `mov reg, ecx` (callee-saved, ecx entry-undef) — linear last-def approximation; evidence entries with ALL accesses fullspan are flagged fullspan_only=true

guards.low_offset: emission requires fingerprint max offset >= 0x40 (C18b precedent: fingerprints inside +0..+0x3F are coverable by nearly any small class = false precision)
guards.dense_exact: exact1 rows whose sole candidate is a >=70%-dense class are NOT emitted (dense classes cover nearly anything: RulesClass absorbed 36/86 exacts before this guard; multi-candidate rows keep dense members flagged in dense_candidates for downstream discount)
guards.blob: members >32B are opaque blobs: kept for size accounting, excluded from coverage spans (zero discrimination)
guards.declared_size: members/observations beyond a class's declared size are dropped (cross-typed receiver pollution: COMClass size=84 had mt obs to 0x168, VoxelTypeClass size=4 had obs to 0x19D0 — frankenstein layouts)

meta.consumption: evidence rows are per-T:FN candidate masks (AND-merge with existing families; heuristic tier like C18 — not a sound exact channel on its own).
